# Mainbrella

> Your clouds. One umbrella.

Mainbrella is a product in development that aims to bring AWS and Google Cloud infrastructure into one dashboard, organized around the products it powers. Compute, databases, and object storage share a product view while retaining their provider, service, and region details.

The website’s dashboard is an illustrative example, not a live connection or a released application. There is no public download or signup yet.

- [Overview](https://mainbrella.com/): Product concept and illustrative dashboard.
- [Availability](https://mainbrella.com/download/): Current release status.
- [Privacy](https://mainbrella.com/privacy/): Privacy policy availability.
- [Terms](https://mainbrella.com/terms/): App terms availability.
